visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene starts with a split-screen view; the top half shows two hands pulling apart a dark cocoa donut, while the bottom shows a man with long hair in a black jacket gesturing excitedly. Bright indoor lighting illuminates the brown and white packaging of Mister Donut and Hershey's. (2) The man is now in a full-frame medium shot standing in a modern kitchen with green cabinets. He holds a piece of a donut while a cartoon yellow chicken graphic appears to his right. (3) A close-up shot focuses on a silver spoon spreading smooth chocolate cream inside a dark donut shell placed on a light-colored plate. (4) Returning to the man, he continues speaking and eating, holding the donut. Pink heart graphics float around him against the white kitchen wall background. (5) A close-up shows hands breaking open a second donut, revealing a light tan pistachio cream filling with a small Hershey's tag on top. visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Variety]: Mister Donut 聯名新品. [Variety]: 被脆燒到了. (2) [Subtitle]: 脆燒我一百萬個好奇的聯名甜甜圈. (3) [Subtitle]: 馬上來吃吃看. (4) [Subtitle]: 可可口味的. (5) [Variety]: 怎麼有禽類. (6) [Subtitle]: 蠻好吃的欸. (7) [Subtitle]: 它內餡很滑順. (8) [Subtitle]: 一般會覺得巧克力很heavy. (9) [Subtitle]: 可是它不會很甜膩. (10) [Subtitle]: 而且嘴巴後面都是巧克力的香氣苦味. (11) [Subtitle]: 一點那種烘焙的焦香感. (12) [Subtitle]: 我很喜歡欸. (13) [Subtitle]: 難怪人家說為了它願意把一天的熱量都花掉. (14) [Variety]: 開心果可可. (15) [Subtitle]: 很濃欸! 我覺得我真的. (16) [Subtitle]: 人都是用眼睛在看事情 (突然吃出一些大道理). (17) [Subtitle]: 沒想到它這個顏色 開心果的味道比那種很綠的還要濃超多. (18) [Subtitle]: 很多人想說這哪是開心果啊 怎麼那麼白 結果超好吃. (19) [Subtitle]: 乾乾的麵包體可以去吸附它內餡的油脂. (20) [Subtitle]: 吃起來在嘴巴裡面是OK的你知道嗎. (21) [Subtitle]: 如果你扣打只有一個你可以優先送開心果 我有驚艷到. (22) [Subtitle]: 開心果59元 這個. (23) [Variety]: 啊. (24) [Subtitle]: 你還在等什麼 (等朋友買給我).
